mechanism_failure.source_review: The cited assistant turn already turns both concerns into a disposable-prototype boundary and a Northline understanding check. Under the frozen ontology, that changes the test and boundary and therefore satisfies the exclusion for unresolved.
mechanism_failure.conclusion: The single joint_status field conflates an unresolved user concern with whether the vanilla assistant answer already covers that concern. Adding context and typed assistant citations did not resolve the conflation.

stop_rule: No further prompt variant, model swap, remaining sentinel, or transfer call is authorized under the current joint-status architecture.

decision_needed.recommended_path: Provider-free decomposition of mechanism state into user-process status and vanilla-answer coverage, with both preserved in the receipt and only uncovered pressure eligible for deterministic routing.
decision_needed.alternative: Keep broad unresolved recall and tolerate duplicate pressure, which conflicts with restraint, false-pressure, and context-dumping rules.
decision_needed.risk_of_recommended_path: A new coverage field can become a probabilistic relevance gate if allowed to delete graph candidates after recall. It must operate before deterministic graph recall, preserve both readings, and never claim mental-model applicability.
